title: 第12章 两大帮派第13章 海鲸帮
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
等进了店铺，让李大海两人入座，坐下之后两人也说出了此次前来的原因。
“这不是看齐兄弟刚来云梦城，店铺又是刚开的，打算给齐兄弟接风洗尘吗。”
“对啊，所以我跟老李来就是想请齐兄弟去酒楼一聚，没想到齐兄弟店铺一直关门，还以为齐兄弟走了呢，搞得老李急得很，哈哈哈哈。”
李大海听到孙千这样说也是有点不好意思，当然，也就有点，毕竟年龄大了，脸皮也厚，只是嘿嘿一笑。
“两位大哥放心，我打算在云梦城久居，等什么时候云梦城的百姓不需要黄粱一梦，我再走也不迟。”
开玩笑，齐源还打算用一城之力供养心雾，怎么会走呢。
至于不需要黄粱一梦？又不是圣人，可以做到无欲无求。
两人一听瞬间钦佩之情从心中涌出，像黄粱一梦这种珍宝，一定很稀有珍贵。
凭借黄粱一梦的能力，直接贡献给王公贵族，肯定能让齐源加官进爵。
但是齐源选择在云梦城外城开间店铺，让普通百姓也有机会接触到，只是为了让人弥补遗憾。
而且使用一次黄粱一梦也只要十两，虽然对普通百姓来说也不便宜，但跟黄粱一梦的效果比，简直就是九牛一毛。
甚至李大海跟孙千还觉得十两银子太低了，要是让他们来，那定个上百两都不是问题，怎么都不可能定个十两银子。
由此两人也更加钦佩齐源，拥有此等珍宝，还想着平民百姓，视金钱跟功名利禄为粪土，称得上是活佛在世也不为过啊！
“齐兄弟真的是菩萨心肠啊，多的不说，要是今后有什么需要我帮忙的，只管说！”
“我也一样，有什么能帮上的，尽管说！”
“哈哈哈哈，那就多谢两位大哥了。”齐源客气的说道。
对于两人心中的想法齐源可以猜到个大概，毕竟黄粱一梦既便宜，效果又好。
连普通百姓都有机会用上，任谁看到都得说一句齐源是个大善人。
“对了，两位大哥，你们可知道哪里可以购买到野兽呢，要活的。”
店铺已经开好了，剑法已经开始学了，现在就剩下吸取气血的途径了。

活的野兽自然比死去的野兽气血要多，能要活的最好，实在不行话死的也可以。
购买野兽总比齐源一个人漫山遍野找野兽要好得多
“活的野兽？”孙千看向李大海。
李大海是开药材铺的，平日里接触很多采药人跟猎户，有的时候一些猎户在山中获得什么珍贵药材，也会到李大海的药铺里面贩卖。
李大海思考了一会说道：“要野兽很简单，外城就有个集市，那里面经常有猎户贩卖野兽，但是活的，那就很少了，而且价格也不便宜，毕竟活的野兽不好抓。”
不过想到齐源手里拥有的黄粱一梦，虽然一次只要十两，但是客人一多，那日进斗金都是少的，银子对齐源来说不是什么问题。
又继续说道：“不过对齐兄弟来说，银子应该不是问题，如果齐兄弟需要的话，我也可以跟认识的猎户说说，到时候有猎到什么野兽，直接联系你。”
“这样既免得去集市收集，齐兄弟也能有个稳定的途径。”
“那就多谢李大哥了。”齐源道了声谢。
李大海摆了摆手：“这都是顺嘴一提的事情，对了，齐兄弟可想好之后店铺的安全问题？”
“李大哥的意思是？”齐源平静的看着李大海。
“最近外城有点不太平，一些帮派开始收保护费了，要是背后没有关系，或者武者撑腰的话，那基本都会被找上门的！”
content_en:
After entering the store, Li Dahai and the two of them were asked to take a seat. After sitting down, the two of them also told the reason for coming this time.
"Isn't it because Brother Qi has just arrived in Yunmeng City and the store has just opened, so he plans to help Brother Qi wash his hands."
"Yes, so Lao Li and I came here just to invite Brother Qi to a restaurant. Unexpectedly, Brother Qi's shop was always closed, and we thought Brother Qi had left. This made Lao Li very anxious, hahahaha."
Li Dahai was a little embarrassed to hear Sun Qian say this, of course, just a little. After all, he was older and thick-skinned, so he just smiled.
"Don't worry, brothers. I plan to stay in Yunmeng City for a long time. When the people of Yunmeng City don't need Huang Liang Yimeng, it won't be too late for me to leave."
Just kidding, Qi Yuan planned to use the power of a city to support Xin Wu, so how could he leave?
As for not needing Huang Liang Yimeng? You are not a saint, you can have no desires and no desires.
When the two heard this, admiration surged out of their hearts. Treasures like Huangliang Yimeng must be very rare and precious.
With Huang Liang Yimeng's ability, directly contributing to the princes and nobles, Qi Yuan will definitely be promoted to a higher position.
But Qi Yuan chose to open a store outside Yunmeng City so that ordinary people could have access to it, just to make up for his regrets.
Moreover, one use of Huangliang Yimeng only costs ten taels. Although it is not cheap for ordinary people, compared with the effect of Huangliang Yimeng, it is simply a drop in the bucket.
Even Li Dahai and Sun Qian felt that ten taels of silver was too low. If they were allowed to come, it wouldn't be a problem to order more than a hundred taels of silver. It would be impossible to order ten taels of silver.
From this, the two of them admired Qi Yuan even more. He owned such treasures, thought about the common people, and regarded money, fame and wealth as rubbish. It is not an exaggeration to call him a living Buddha!
"Brother Qi is really a bodhisattva-hearted person. I don't want to say anything. If you need my help in the future, just say it!"
"Me too, if there's anything you can do to help, just ask!"
"Hahahaha, thank you two big brothers." Qi Yuan said politely.
Qi Yuan could roughly guess what they were thinking. After all, Huangliang Yimeng was cheap and effective.
Even ordinary people have the opportunity to use it. Anyone who sees it will have to say that Qi Yuan is a good person.
"By the way, brothers, do you know where to buy wild beasts? They need to be alive."
The shop has been opened, the swordsmanship has been learned, and now the only way to absorb the energy and blood is.
Living beasts naturally have more vitality and blood than dead beasts, so they can live the best they can. If not, they can die.
It is much better to buy wild beasts than to search for wild beasts alone in the mountains and plains.
"A living beast?" Sun Qian looked at Li Dahai.
Li Dahai runs a medicine shop, and he comes into contact with many herbal collectors and hunters. Sometimes some hunters get precious medicinal materials in the mountains and sell them in Li Dahai's medicine shop.
Li Dahai thought for a while and said: "It's easy to get wild beasts. There is a market in the outer city. There are often hunters selling wild beasts there, but there are very few live ones, and the price is not cheap. After all, live wild beasts are difficult to catch."
However, thinking about the Huangliang Yimeng that Qi Yuan has in his hand, although it only costs ten taels at a time, when there are more guests, the daily amount of gold will be small, so money is not a problem for Qi Yuan.
Then he continued: "But for Brother Qi, money should not be a problem. If Brother Qi needs it, I can also tell the hunters I know. If I hunt any wild beasts, I will contact you directly."
"This way, we don't have to go to the market to collect, and Brother Qi can have a stable way."
"Thank you so much, Brother Li." Qi Yuan thanked him.
Li Dahai waved his hand: "This is just a casual mention. By the way, has Brother Qi thought about the safety of the store in the future?"
"What does Brother Li mean?" Qi Yuan looked at Li Dahai calmly.
"Recently there areIt's a bit unsettling. Some gangs have begun to charge protection fees. If there are no connections behind the scenes, or if there are warriors backing them, they will basically be found! "
